verdict.rationale: The private equity page says the firm advises venture capital funds and covers growth transactions, PIPEs, buyouts and exits. It cites one representative capital raise, Hygenco's USD 105 million round from IFC, Siemens and Fullerton, and the homepage lists start-ups and VC funds as clients. There is no dedicated venture financing practice and no evidence of seed or early-stage priced rounds. Missing for 10: a dedicated venture financing practice page, seed and early-stage round coverage, stated deal volume, and multiple representative venture rounds across stages.
